summary: Vaxart, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the formation of two new board committees on August 21, 2026: the Clinical and Regulatory Affairs Committee and the Stockholder Engagement Committee. Members were appointed, with a future director expected to chair the latter under a Cooperation Agreement dated July 1, 2026. No transaction, dispute, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is routine corporate governance and forward-looking statements, not a special situation.
